title: Handoff Friction Scorecard — April 2030
content:
Purpose: lightweight, cross-team scorecard to capture short-run handoff friction spots that are causing repeated slowdowns (build / deploy / support rotations). Use as a daily snapshot for the 10–15 minute ops sync.

Layout (columns): RowID | Handoff Area | Owning Team | Current Owner | Friction (1-5) | Primary Block | Last Action (date) | Time-to-resolve estimate | Linked ticket(s) | Quick notes / ask 

Rows:
1 | Hosted API incident routing | infra / serving-runtime | Amara P. | 4 | Missing runbook for region failover when model variant mismatch occurs | 2030-04-07 | 48h | JIRA-OPS-412, PR-3421 | Runbook draft 40% — need SRE signoff; temporary fallback created but not automated.

2 | Dedicated capacity onboarding | sales + dedicated | Diego M. | 3 | Billing metadata delayed, provisioning blocked on quota request | 2030-04-09 | 72h | JIRA-PROD-1987 | Sales reported customer hit a weekend delay; ops manual step exists but not documented end-to-end.

3 | Private deployment cert rotation | private-deployments | Sofia N. | 5 | Certificate rotation process unclear across customer-managed KMS configs | 2030-04-06 | 96h | none yet | High-priority for customers in EMEA; blocking 2 active installs. Need runbook + checklists.

4 | Console rollout A/B toggle mismatch | product/console | Noah B. | 2 | Toggle service cache inconsistent during canary | 2030-04-10 | 24h | GH-frontend-804 | Minor but recurring; can be mitigated by shorter TTL for toggle cache.

5 | Model quantization handoff notes | applied-ml | Lena Park | 3 | Missing model metadata (bitwidth/conf) in handoff bundle | 2030-04-11 | 48h | ML-QUANT-59 | Causes extra iteration between applied-ml and serving runtime; adding a simple manifest field suggested.

6 | Support escalation route for embedding regressions | customer-success | Priya Shah | 4 | No clarified owner when embeddings degrade post-deploy | 2030-04-12 | 72h | CS-574 | Need SLA for who owns first triage (CS vs applied-ml). Put on weekly CS <> ML cadence.

7 | Overnight batch job retries | infra/sre | Marco Rossi | 2 | Retry backoff not aligned with Dedicated autoscale windows | 2030-04-13 | 36h | SRE-269 | Low impact but noisy alerts; propose minor config tweak.

8 | Eval-suite result handoff | research/applied-ml | Hana Ito | 3 | Versioning mismatch in eval harness vs model served | 2030-04-09 | 48h | EVAL-112 | Add ver-tag in eval output and serve manifest; quick win.

Notes (informal / actionable):
- Quick definitions: Friction 5 = blocks >2 customers or escalates to exec; 1 = cosmetic/tiny.
- This sheet is intentionally minimal: capture one-sentence problem, who to ping, and an ETA.
- Use Slack prefix "ops-handoff" for any updates so sync callers can find context quickly.
- If a row's ETA slips, owner should add a one-line reason in Quick notes.

Unresolved questions / quick ideas:
- Should we auto-create a templated JIRA from rows that hit Friction >=4? (Pros: traceability. Cons: noise.)
- Consider a tiny webhook from this sheet to notify #oncall when a Friction is bumped to 5.
- Can product-ops own the small runbook templates to reduce friction when multiple teams touch the same handoff?

Immediate next steps (owner assignments):
- Amara: finalize runbook skeleton and schedule SRE review by 2030-04-15.
- Diego: confirm quota request flow and add a one-line public note in the sales playbook by 2030-04-16.
- Sofia: draft cert rotation checklist and surface to privacy/compliance for EMEA installs by 2030-04-18.

Quick status log (top-line):
- 2030-04-08: initial scan created by Jordan L. after ops sync; seeded with items from last 2 weeks.
- 2030-04-11: added Dedicated onboarding row after sales postmortem.
- 2030-04-13: SRE flagged retry noise; added Marco as owner.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Keep this file lightweight. Avoid converting every item into a full Jira unless it becomes recurring or customer-impacting.
- If we start templating runbooks, keep them <1 page with clear cutover steps.

Tags (for import / search): handoff, ops-scan, short-run, runbook-needed, quick-fix

References: Confluence quick scan template (linked above), recent Slack thread in #ops-handoff-thread (see linked_artifacts).

End of sheet.
